### Screenshot 1: Sessions Manager Dialog
**Rating: 8/10**

*   **Element Cut-off:** The black vertical line (likely a map route or UI overlay) passes directly behind the dialog, visually cutting through the left edge of the modal container.
*   **Contrast/Visibility:** The "X" close button in the top-right corner of the dialog has very low contrast against the white background, making it difficult to see.

### Screenshot 2: Mobile Batch Queue
**Rating: 7/10**

*   **Truncation:** The application title in the top-left header ("GPX Repair St...") is truncated and does not display the full name.
*   **Overlap/Cut-off:** The circular "N" compass button in the bottom-left corner overlaps with the text content ("Presets use the shipped..."), obstructing the bottom-left area of the page.
